description: GNN evaluation on Flyvis-217 under 1/5-frame subsampling (s5h06), condl25 arm, dataset flyvis_noise_005_blank50_cv00, 10/10 folds landed. Model is the general-form GNN flyvis_conductance (g_phi = MLP(a_i, a_j, v_i, v_j)), embedding dim 2, model noise sigma 0.05, trained 20 epochs, batch 4, data augmentation loop 50, recurrent with rollout horizon 6 to 6, fp32. Regularizers: W_L1 7.5e-5, W_L2 7.5e-7, g_phi input group L1 25.0, g_phi weight L1 0.14, f_theta weight L1 0.025.
facts:
CAPTION: GNN evaluation across degraded Flyvis-217; model noise σ = 0.05, 5-fold CV (mean ± SD) with variable measurement noise (γ), unknown stimulus, added/removed edges, sub- sampled frames, and hidden neurons. Every row is the general-form GNN (gϕ = MLP(ai, aj, vi, vj), group lasso 25; group lasso 100 whe SECTION: 1/5 frames
FACTS:
- experiment: 5: 1/5 frames observed
- arm: cond_l25
- runs: 10 of 10 landed
- dataset: flyvis_noise_005_blank50_cv00
- model: flyvis_conductance
- embedding dim: 2
- model noise sigma: 0.05
- epochs: 20
- batch: 4
- data augmentation loop: 50
- training: recurrent, horizon 6 to 6
- MLP precision: fp32
- regularisers: W_L1 7.5e-05, W_L2 7.5e-07, g_phi_input_group_L1 25.0, g_phi_weight_L1 0.14, f_theta_weight_L1 0.025
GLOSSARY (meaning of identifier fragments; use only these):
- blank50: in every video clip of the stimulus, the first 50% of the frames are replaced by blank frames
- cv00 .. cv04: cross-validation folds 0 to 4
- noise_free / noise_005 / noise_05: model noise sigma 0 / 0.05 / 0.5
- 010 / 020 after noise_005: measurement noise gamma 0.1 / 0.2
- flyvis_conductance: code name of the general-form GNN, g_phi = MLP(a_i, a_j, v_i, v_j)
- flyvis_known_ode: code name of the Known-ODE model (the generator's equation with learned W, tau, V_rest)
- condl25 / condl100: group lasso 25 / 100 on g_phi's input groups
- null_edges_pc_400 / null400: 400% extra null edges added to the connectome
- removed_pc_20 / rm20, removed_pc_50 / rm50: 20% / 50% of the edges removed
- hidden_020 / hid20, hid10: 20% / 10% of the neurons hidden
- s5h06 / s5h21: one frame in five observed, rollout horizon 6 / 21
- INR_davis: stimulus not given, learned by a SIREN network
- full_eye_flywireRF / e8_flywireRF: FlyWire eye / e8 hybrid connectome; proximal_nulls: with proximal null edges
